specs.title: SCN-001: The trainee signs in to the Secure Area

steps.title: Given I am on the Login page
When I sign in with the training account
Then I am on the Secure Area with the heading "Secure Area"
And I see "You logged into a secure area!"

specs.title: SCN-002.1: Wrong credentials are refused with a specific message (an unknown username)

steps.title: Given I am on the Login page
When I sign in with an unknown username
Then I see "Your username is invalid!"
And I am still on the Login page

steps.title: Given I am on the Login page

specs.title: SCN-003: Logging out returns to the Login page

steps.title: Given I am signed in as the trainee
When I log out
Then I am on the Login page
And I see "You logged out of the secure area!"

specs.title: SCN-004: The Secure Area is not reachable while signed out

steps.title: When I open /secure without signing in
Then I am on the Login page
And I see "You must login to view the secure area!"

specs.title: SCN-005: Checkboxes start in the documented state and toggle

steps.title: Given I am on the Checkboxes page
Then checkbox 1 is unchecked and checkbox 2 is checked
When I click both checkboxes
Then checkbox 1 is checked and checkbox 2 is unchecked

specs.title: SCN-006: The dropdown offers the documented options

steps.title: Given I am on the Dropdown page
Then the options are "Please select an option", "Option 1" and "Option 2"
And "Please select an option" is preselected and cannot be selected
When I choose "Option 2"
Then "Option 2" is the selected option
